description: Add a note to a CLIENT's history (shows on the client page) or to a booking — e.g. log a call, an inquiry reply, or what was agreed. Pass client_id (and/or booking_id) and comment. contact_id (optional) ties the note to the person at the client it is about; it must be one of that client's contacts. Use this (or add_client_note) to put a note on a client — add_project_note is a shared notepad not tied to any client.

booking_id.description: A booking's id (from list_bookings or search).

client_id.description: A client's id (from search or list_clients).
